data.narrative:
Project Omega, a seed-stage nuclear energy company led by Stafford Sheehan, has raised $12M to date. The broader nuclear energy sector comprises 3 public comps (OKLO, NNE, SMR) and 8 private peers including Nano Nuclear Energy, Oklo, Valar Atomics, X-Energy, and Fuse Energy.

The Stage-Progression method is applicable here, using the $12M total raised as a valuation proxy and applying a 2.5x multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage advancement in frontier tech. This yields an implied valuation of $30M. The Peer-Median approach is not applicable: while 5 same-sector peers exist, insufficient overlap emerges when filtering for identical or adjacent stage, similar valuation tier, or comparable funding profiles—fewer than 3 datapoints survive any narrow filter. Relying on all-sector median would introduce undue noise given the heterogeneity of nuclear tech maturity profiles.

The triangulation supports a valuation range of $26M (low) to $34M (high), centered on $30M. This range reflects a single applicable method and carries material uncertainty around stage-appropriate multiples in an immature, capital-intensive sector where comparable recent transactions remain sparse. The primary risk to this range is the scarcity of disclosed funding events at Project Omega's exact stage and specificity within nuclear energy, limiting conviction in the step-up multiplier applied.
